about: Who asked for a figure or object to be sculpted (BST send-back). A lane adds a row here, or asks BST to. Key: 'scene:<scene key>', 'file:<glb name without .glb>' or 'asset:<library id>'. The Send back tile in the sculpt menu appears when the open scene or figure matches a row; it saves the sculpt to the library and sends the picture and the library id to that lane's inbox.

scene:bst_leslie_mouth.what: the mouth of the Leslie Knope head swap
scene:bst_leslie_mouth.name: Leslie Knope head swap mouth fixed
scene:bst_leslie_mouth.how: To look at it: open the glb above in the Atelier (Props > From the library) or load it as the figure file in a BSA scene. The jaw bone j22 and the cloth_* piece names are as in the figure you sent.
